variation.name: bir51_combined_baseline
variation.description: A complete BIR51 filing comprising a paired tax computation data file and financial statements data file. Both files are in HKD. ProfitLossBeforeTax must be identical in both files (NVAD-E-1390). Monetary facts in the FS file must use HKD units consistent with the functional currency declared in the TC file (NVAD-E-1430).
